# SMT2 study tables (generated by perfmodel/scripts/smt_tables.py; do not edit)

WS_ref: weighted speedup against each program alone on v1_freeze. WS: against each program alone on the same configuration (threads=1). Fairness: harmonic mean of the per-thread speedups (same configuration). Figures are geometric means of the three group geometric means; throughput is the mean over pairs of the summed IPC. LUT estimates: scripts/report.py per-entry costs, plus the SMT2 overhead (central estimate 6,400 LUTs) for threads=2.

## SMT2 overhead estimate (per core)

| Item | Low | Central | High | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Second rename map and committed map | 500 | 800 | 1,100 | 2 x (32 x 8 + 32 x 7) flip-flops; every rename read port selects from 64 entries instead of 32; restore paths |
| Second set of 4 rename checkpoints | 400 | 500 | 600 | ~125 LUTs per checkpoint, as in the M1 cost model |
| Second FTQ, global history, RAS and fetch PC | 500 | 700 | 950 | 32-entry FTQ and RAS in LUTRAM with their read ports, history register and repair, redirect muxing |
| Per-thread instruction queue and decode-to-rename queue | 150 | 300 | 450 | the 16-entry instruction queue already sits in 32-deep LUTRAM (pointers only); a 6-uop holding queue per thread |
| ICOUNT fetch arbitration, per-thread occupancy counters and caps | 200 | 300 | 450 | pre-issue uop counters, comparators, cap checks on the issue queues, MSHRs and long-latency tags |
| TID tags and partitions in the ROB, LQ, SQ and completion buffer | 300 | 500 | 700 | per-partition head/tail pointers, TID match in the forwarding and ordering CAMs, TID-qualified kill |
| Sibling stores on the snoop path; per-hart LR reservation (rule 4) | 50 | 100 | 150 | a committing store checks the sibling's executed loads through the existing snoop port |
| Second CSR file, trap, interrupt, timer and debug state | 1,500 | 2,000 | 2,800 | M/S CSRs, fcsr and 16 PMP entries per hart (PMP check logic shared), per-hart trap sequencing, mip/mie, debug |
| Second set of performance counters | 600 | 1,000 | 1,300 | mcycle, minstret and 16 HPM counters per hart |
| MMU: TID in TLB and walk-cache tags, per-thread walk requests | 100 | 200 | 300 | tags already sized for the TID in v1 (plan 4.10); a request queue per thread |
| **Total** | **4,300** (10.5%) | **6,400** (15.6%) | **8,800** (21.5%) | of the ≈41K-LUT core |
